  • Method Details

    • assignMark

      public void assignMark(Teacher teacher, Course course, String studentId, double first, double second, double finalExam)
      Creates a mark and records it in the course. If the total is below 50 the student's fail counter is incremented and an alert is printed if the limit is exceeded. GPA is recalculated and the student is saved to disk afterwards.
      Parameters:
      teacher - the teacher assigning the mark
      course - the course the mark belongs to
      studentId - the student's ID
      first - attestation 1 score (0–30)
      second - attestation 2 score (0–30)
      finalExam - final exam score (0–40)
